glossary.definition: (A) "Unit" means a company, battery, troop, air squadron, band, or detachment.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 5911., 5913., 5919., 5920., 5923., and 5924. of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Organization" means a command composed of two or more units.
